output.explanation: Verified against checkout fe3552441192ccbea91d117668e7f3a9eb097baf. The central tree now follows runtime ownership: Session.Service constructs its handle facade; SessionExecution constructs the run and report coordinators; LocationServiceMap retains borrowed Instance graphs; each location runner constructs its SessionStep closure. Shared dependencies remain siblings with explicit call arrows. Two peripheral diagrams expand host persistence/admission and location capabilities, including direct links between their interacting services. Corrections and clarifications: handles do not own the runtime services; SessionStep is a closure, not another service; removal deletes the parent before recursively deleting children; command dispatch invokes Command.execute rather than necessarily admitting a prompt; output truncation occurs at the step caller; location invalidation detaches routing while borrowers retain the old graph. Child creation fixes location to the parent's location, permits metadata/permission overrides, and does not automatically inherit agent/model selection. Execution exclusivity is process-local and restart recovery is at-least-once. Group headings denote composition, not additional service objects.
